g.text: The installer prepares inputs. The instance reads its secret and builds pinned kits.
DNS for public access, not internal probes
Build one kit at a time
KEY: blue AWS | green service | brown data | red identity | gray external | solid core | dashed option
The secret exists before boot. User data checks SnapshotCommit before it runs any script of the clone.
Docker drop-in: tenant-ec2-storage.conf requires four durable mounts and the metadata guard before Docker starts.
Verify: compose ps, file-set test, service list, then verify-deployed.py with file set and public names.
Verify uses internal requests only. It runs no kits.lock verify line and proves no login, public route or model answer.
The bootstrap writes COMPOSE_FILE into the host environment file. A manual Compose command uses the same overlays.
The host keeps generated service keys. The installer saves them and updates the secret after boot.
This picture is an install order, not a deploy approval. No AWS, Entra, DNS or credential-store change runs here.
Frames group related parts. Dashed component boxes mark options; all other component boxes mark the core.
